outcomes: A publisher and a Putnami Go module registry written against the contract and its fixtures exchange a module version through one authenticated, strictly parsed write
A version is bound to the bytes the registry stored, never to bytes it did not receive
Reads stay the standard Go module proxy protocol, so go mod download works unmodified
nonGoals: The read side, which is the public Go module proxy protocol
A JSON Schema: the Go types, the strict parsers and the shared fixtures are the contract
Channel naming, which is a registry policy and leaves dist_tag unconstrained here
How the publish job builds the zip, retries and smoke-tests the version, which the Go extension and the extension SDK own

requirements.text: The protocol version is 1. The blob upload path is /<module>/-/blobs/upload, with content type application/zip. The version path is /<module>/@v/<version>, and the release path is the version path followed by /release, both with content type application/json. A test pins each value, so a change is a reviewed bump.
A publish request carries go_mod, zip_digest and dist_tag, and omits dist_tag when no channel is set. A release response carries module, version and visibility.
The error codes are exactly gomod.invalid_blob_upload, gomod.invalid_publish, gomod.invalid_digest, gomod.invalid_go_mod and gomod.invalid_release.

Every valid fixture of the blob upload response, the publish request and the release response parses with no error. Every invalid fixture fails: a malformed digest, an unknown field, a missing go_mod, a missing module or version, and a visibility other than public.
A release response followed by a second JSON value is refused, and so is a release response that names another version than the one requested.

The SDK publisher (tooling/extension-sdk) uploads the zip, then PUTs the version under its bearer, and a second publish of the same bytes reuses the version. It refuses an upload answer whose digest is not its zip's. On a 409 it reuses the version only when the caller allows an existing version.

The Go extension's publish job (go/extension) sends a publish request that parses strictly, with no dist_tag, and calls no release, in a full bootstrap and in an unmanaged publish. In the full bootstrap the request has no visibility member.
